newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Woodchester sell-off moves closer.
newsitem.headline: Woodchester sell-off moves closer.

text.p: Irish financial services group Woodchester Investments Plc said on Thursday it had invited several interested parties to conduct due diligence reviews and that they were expected to continue until the end of May.

Woodchester said in March that its main shareholder, France's Credit Lyonnais, planned to sell its 54 percent stake in the group, opening the way for other parties to make full bids for the Irish investment group.

"On completion of all reviews, the (Woodchester) board with its advisers will then enter into final negotiations for the sale of the entire issued share capital of Woodchester," the Irish company said in a statement.
Woodchester, which has said it was confident of finding a favourable offer, said earlier on Thursday that new business grew by more than 30 percent in the first four months of this year.
